title: domain: create crate structure
description: Initialize the clarity-web/src/domain directory and its core modules (types, error, quality) to centralize the shared data models and unify the quality algebra.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a unified domain layer for shared types.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL include the src/domain module in the crate root.

unwanted.condition: IF the src/domain module attempts to import from src/intent or src/lattice
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the dependency to exist
unwanted.because: it violates the functional core isolation principle.

preconditions: No existing src/domain module is defined in lib.rs
invariants: All types in src/domain MUST derive Serialize and Deserialize
The domain module has zero internal crate dependencies

questions: Should we move existing types in this step? (Assumption: No, that is task-002+)
